source.title: Fantasy Football 2026: Best running back handcuffs
source.author: Ryan Conway
source.summary: Three backups with credible paths to fantasy relevance if the starter ahead of them misses time.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Brooks can become Carolina's most explosive back if his recovery from consecutive ACL tears restores his college form.
takeaways.rationale: Brooks can become Carolina's most explosive back if his recovery from consecutive ACL tears restores his college form.
risks: He has only nine NFL carries and substantial medical risk.

takeaways.label: value
takeaways.summary: Corum matched Kyren Williams' rushing grade and produced explosive runs on much lower volume, giving him both standalone growth and immediate starter upside if Williams misses time.
takeaways.rationale: Corum matched Kyren Williams' rushing grade and produced explosive runs on much lower volume, giving him both standalone growth and immediate starter upside if Williams misses time.
risks: Williams remains the clear lead back.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Wright becomes fantasy relevant in Miami's run-heavy plan if De'Von Achane misses time, with enough efficiency to handle expanded volume.
takeaways.rationale: Wright becomes fantasy relevant in Miami's run-heavy plan if De'Von Achane misses time, with enough efficiency to handle expanded volume.
risks: He played only 127 offensive snaps and fumbled twice on 70 carries.
